import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter, usePathname } from "next/navigation";

export function Nav() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  return (
    <nav>
      <Link href="/" prefetch={false}>Home</Link>
      <Link href="/docs" className="nav">Docs</Link>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => router.push("/login")}>Log in</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => router.replace("/")}>Home</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => router.back()}>Back</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => router.refresh()}>Reload {pathname}</button>
      <button type="button" onMouseEnter={() => router.prefetch("/docs")}>Docs</button>
    </nav>
  );
}
